title: Radiation-induced skeletal muscle injury English review: writing control architecture

root_goal.statement: Produce a submission-ready English narrative/systematic-style review on radiation-induced skeletal muscle injury in which every reference exists and supports the sentence citing it, every number matches its source, and conclusions do not exceed the evidence; Bruce alone decides whether and where to submit.
root_goal.observable_success: Final manuscript where (1) 100% of references resolve to a real PubMed/Crossref record with matching title/authors/year/DOI and are not retracted, (2) 100% of numeric statements have a traced quote/table location in the retrieved full text and match exactly (unit, denominator, species, dose), (3) the overclaim check finds zero claims rated stronger than their evidence level, (4) screening log reproduces from the frozen search strings, and (5) Bruce signs off the final version. Secondary: the audit's independent re-search finds no missed key study meeting criteria; readability is judged by Bruce, never traded against accuracy.
out_of_scope: Submitting the manuscript, choosing the journal, paying fees or emailing editors (Bruce decides and does this)
Generating new experimental data or meta-analytic claims not supported by included studies
Changing the review question, inclusion criteria or search strings without Bruce's approval
Citing any paper whose record or full text/abstract was not actually retrieved
root_goal.proxy_metrics_note: coverage_completeness and readability_score are secondary, gameable metrics (pad corpus, fluent hype); they rank below accuracy per priority policy and are countered by corpus_audit, citation/number verifiers and overclaim_counter

classification_rationale: Not a single loop: drafting optimizes a gameable proxy (fluency/novelty/coverage) that directly conflicts with three independent truth checks (reference existence, numeric fidelity, claim strength). Each check needs evidence the writer cannot produce or alter (external bibliographic databases and retrieved full texts), veto power, an arbitration order when coverage/novelty pull against accuracy, a slower audit for search freshness/retractions/screening drift, and a human gate because submission and protocol changes belong to Bruce. Search/screen and draft/revise are themselves bounded iterative loops, hence graph_plus_loop.

allowed_actions: Run the frozen search strings in PubMed/Web of Science/Scopus and log results
Retrieve abstracts and legally accessible full texts into the evidence store
Screen records against frozen inclusion/exclusion criteria with logged reasons
Draft and revise manuscript text in the working repository
Resolve DOIs/PMIDs via Crossref/PubMed APIs and check retraction status
Propose protocol or scope changes to Bruce
forbidden_actions: Submit the manuscript or contact journals/editors
Add a reference without a retrieved bibliographic record and source text
Write a number not traced to a quoted location in a source
Edit the frozen protocol, verification rules, anchors or priority policy
Mark the manuscript complete without verifier passes and Bruce sign-off

frozen_rules: Review protocol (question, PICO-style scope, inclusion/exclusion criteria, search strings, databases, date cut-off) is frozen once Bruce approves it; changes only via Bruce
Reference rule: a citation is valid only if its PMID/DOI resolves in PubMed/Crossref with matching metadata, is not retracted, and the cited claim is supported by retrieved abstract/full text
Number rule: every numeric statement carries a source-quote locator; mismatch in value, unit, denominator, species, dose or fractionation is a veto

Claim-strength rubric: preclinical/animal/in vitro findings may not be stated as clinical effects; association may not be stated as causation; 'first/novel/paradigm' wording requires explicit evidence
Priority order: citation/number accuracy > claim-evidence alignment > coverage completeness > novelty/readability
Writer and searcher may not edit verifier code, rubrics, anchors or the audit sample

failure_policy.failed: If a section fails citation or number verification after max iterations, strip the unsupported sentences, mark them in the issues log and escalate to Bruce; never paper over with alternative citations not retrieved
failure_policy.blocked: If full texts are inaccessible or databases unreachable, stop the affected section, record which sources are missing and ask Bruce for access or scope decision
failure_policy.budget_exhausted: Freeze the latest fully verified version, hand off with open-issues list to Bruce; do not ship unverified text

conditions: completed: all verifiers pass on the same frozen version, audit clean, Bruce signs off
failed: verification still failing after max iterations on any section
blocked: source access, protocol ambiguity or anchor stale beyond max_age_days
budget_exhausted: retries or cost units used up
stop_handoff.artifact: handoff.md (final verified manuscript, reference verification table, number trace table, overclaim report, PRISMA-style screening log, open issues)

arbitration.priority_policy: Citation/number accuracy > claim-evidence alignment > coverage completeness > novelty/readability; any veto from citation, number or overclaim checks overrides writer quality scores; unresolved conflicts escalate to Bruce

verification.independence_statement: Verifiers run in fresh context, do not see the writer's reasoning, and re-fetch evidence themselves from PubMed/Crossref/Retraction Watch and the retrieved full-text store rather than trusting writer-provided summaries; number checks are deterministic string/table matches against source text; the overclaim checker uses a frozen rubric and a different model/prompt from the writer.

checks.criterion: Every reference resolves in PubMed/Crossref with matching metadata, is not retracted, and its retrieved text supports the citing sentence
checks.evidence: reference verification table with API responses and supporting quotes
checks.failure_signal: unresolvable/mismatched/retracted reference or unsupported citing sentence -> veto

checks.criterion: Every numeric statement exactly matches a quoted location in the source (value, unit, denominator, species, dose/fractionation)
checks.evidence: number trace table with source locators
checks.failure_signal: any untraced or mismatched number -> veto

counter_checks.criterion: No conclusion rated stronger than its evidence level per frozen rubric; no unsupported novelty wording

anchors.source: Bruce-approved review protocol (question, criteria, search strings, databases, cut-off date)
anchors.freshness_rule: Valid until Bruce approves a revision; re-confirm if drafting spans more than 90 days

anchors.source: External bibliographic records (PubMed, Crossref, Retraction Watch database) and retrieved original full texts/abstracts
anchors.evidence_form: API responses (PMID/DOI metadata, retraction flag) and stored source PDFs/text with hashes
anchors.owner: External databases / publishers (read-only to the system)
anchors.freshness_rule: Re-query metadata and retraction status within 30 days before handoff; search re-run if older than cut-off policy

nodes.responsibility: Frozen review protocol approved by Bruce
Independent bibliographic and full-text ground truth

inputs: PMID/DOI/full-text queries issued by verifiers and audit

nodes.responsibility: Run frozen searches, deduplicate, screen titles/abstracts/full texts with logged reasons, retrieve sources
Outline, draft and revise sections only from the evidence table; each claim tagged with source ID and quote locator
Resolve every reference against PubMed/Crossref, check retraction, and check that the cited source actually supports the sentence
Match every numeric statement (doses, fractions, n, effect sizes, percentages, time points) to the quoted location in the source text
Counter the novelty/readability proxy: rate each conclusion's strength against evidence level (species, model, design, sample size); flag hype words and unsupported 'novel/first' claims
Re-run frozen searches on a sample to check screening reproducibility and missed key studies, re-check retractions and source freshness, sample-audit verifier decisions
Combine verifier/counter/audit verdicts by frozen priority policy; decide revise vs strip vs escalate
nodes.priority_policy: Citation/number accuracy > claim-evidence alignment > coverage completeness > novelty/readability

nodes.responsibility: Review whether scope, criteria or rubric need revision based on audit drift and recurring conflicts; only proposes changes
Bruce reviews the verified version, approves protocol changes, accepts residual risks, and alone decides submission
Package final verified manuscript, verification tables, screening log and open issues for Bruce

edges.artifact: bibliographic records, retraction flags, source texts
included corpus with PMIDs/DOIs, evidence extraction table
final-version reference verification table (re-run on the exact signed-off version)
pre-handoff audit findings (retractions, freshness, missed studies)
